page.overview:
What is Petunia Evans?

Petunia Dursley (née Evans) (pre-1960–pre-2020) was an English Muggle woman, the older daughter of Mrs and Mr Evans and the older sister of the Muggle-born witch Lily Potter. During her childhood, she became resentful of her younger sister for being a witch, broke off contact with her and refused to have any contact with the wizarding world.

She married a Muggle, Vernon Dursley and they had a son, Dudley. However, when Lily and her husband were murdered by Lord Voldemort, Petunia became the legal guardian of her sororal nephew, Harry Potter, who was only one year old then. She neglected and treated him cruelly for the most part (mainly due to her aversion to the Potters being wizards) and confined him to sleep in the cupboard under the stairs (although she allowed him a room of his own after receiving his acceptance letters to Hogwarts in order to attempt to trick Hogwarts into not sending letters).

In 1991, when Rubeus Hagrid came and said that Harry would go to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, she became very angry at the fact her sororal nephew had discovered his true magical heritage. She and her family left their home in 1997 in order to be protected from Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters.

After the Second Wizarding War, her son married and she had two paternal grandchildren. Through her sororal nephew's marriage to Ginny Weasley, she had two sororal great-nephews, James Sirius and Albus Severus Potter, the former named after her late brother-in-law and a sororal great-niece, Lily Luna Potter, named after her late younger sister.
